crop_preview.semantics: Simulation of the current 58%-height wall image box using an exact reviewed lower-face focus that preserves the Wolf Man's eyes, nose, mouth, hair and ear.

notes: The selected Universal/Realart lobby-card extract visibly depicts Lon Chaney Jr. as the Wolf Man, with the full transformed face and defining hair, brow, eyes, nose, teeth, beard and ear legible.
The exact Wikimedia Commons page describes the image as Lon Chaney Jr. as the title character and identifies it as an extract from The Wolf Man lobby card.
The Commons source records Universal Studios, a 1948 Realart re-release and public-domain status in the United States due to publication without a copyright notice.
The first default upper-face crop was rejected because it cut off the mouth; the reviewed y=0.60 crop preserves the complete expression and defining makeup evidence.
The candidate is not an unmasked performer portrait, unrelated person, group image, logo, poster typography or generic werewolf namesake.
